items.title: Anthropic invests $50 billion in American AI infrastructure
items.summary: Anthropic is partnering with Fluidstack to build data centers in Texas and New York, creating roughly 800 permanent and 2,400 construction jobs.
items.summaryZh: 本文来自Anthropic News，围绕“Anthropic invests $50 billion in American AI infrastructure”介绍模型发布方面的最新进展，重点涉及Anthropic、模型发布。下方为系统保存的原文正文。
